title: Flour mills in the French national surveys of 1794, 1801 and 1809 (Archives nationales F/20; data.gouv.fr)
describe: Water mills, windmills and boat mills recorded commune by commune in the State's mill surveys of year II (1794, 72 départements), year X (1801, the départements supplying Paris) and 1809 (national, including annexed parts of Belgium, Germany and Italy); each record is shown as a snapshot of its survey, placed at its commune (approximate).
